title: Collect granules with a sleeve-and-notched-rod sampler
instruction: Collect at least 5 grams of granules from the tub into the sample jar using the sleeve-and-notched-rod sampler. Return the closed sampler upright to its holder and release both hands.
context: A contained subsample of granular feedstock is a preparation step for laboratory formulation and materials experiments. This task tests exposing and filling a sampling notch within the material, enclosing it before withdrawal, then coordinating tool tilt and button pressure to discharge into a separate jar. Operating procedure: Buerkle powder sampler Mini, https://www.buerkle.de/en/powder-sampler-mini_p5346-3010 .
setup: Calibrated bimanual YAM station with standard parallel grippers, tabletop at z=0.7475 m and the native overview/left-wrist/right-wrist cameras. A sleeve-and-notched-rod sampler starts upright at (0.28, -0.06, 0.7535) m in a polymer holder: 116 x 116 x 6 mm foot, 100 mm clear opening, 30 mm walls. Its aluminum/polycarbonate outer body weighs 280 g: lower sleeve 48 x 48 x 38 mm, 42 mm clear bore, 3 mm walls and a 6 mm chamfered mouth; hollow barrel to 270 mm, rubber-covered 24 x 24 x 80 mm grip and 36 mm finger rest. The 85 g aluminum/polymer moving rod has a 40 x 40 x 23 mm side-notched pocket with a 4 mm integral floor, 6 mm square shaft and 30 mm diameter blue button. Button/rod stroke: 25 mm. Polymer source tub: 105 x 105 mm inside, 145 mm walls, 3 mm thick, floor reference (0.40, 0.02, 0.7475) m. Material: 1,960 dry polymer spheres, 6.8 mm diameter and 0.18 g each, reset as a 14 x 14 x 10 lattice at 7.1 mm pitch and settled. Polymer receiving jar: 110 x 110 mm inside, 95 mm walls, 3 mm thick, floor reference (0.22, 0.10, 0.7475) m. Polymer containment tray: 520 x 620 mm inside, 50 mm walls, 8 mm base, centered at (0.40, 0.16) m. Tub, jar, holder and tray are fixed to the table. README, scene-inventory.json and setup-layout.json give the complete dimensions and transforms; printable tool and fixture models are supplied in reconstruction/.
scoring: 0.0: less than 2 g of eligible sample settled in the jar. 0.4: at least 2 g but less than 5 g. 0.7: at least 5 g. 1.0: at least 5 g, with the sampler closed, upright in its holder, at rest and released by both hands for 1 second. Eligible material must enter the exposed notch from the source, remain inside after retraction, then leave through the exposed notch and settle in the jar; a filled sampler held in the jar earns no delivery. Closed means rod extension <=2 mm. Upright means sleeve axis within 11.48 degrees of vertical. The 48 x 48 mm sleeve must fit inside the 100 mm holder opening and its base lie within 5 mm of the holder support height. At rest means tool linear speed <15 mm/s, angular speed <0.15 rad/s, and grain speed <15 mm/s; both grippers are >40 mm open and clear of the tool. Any granule falling below tabletop minus 5 mm, the sampler leaving the declared work area, or nonfinite simulation state permanently scores 0. Detailed whole-grain, clearance and measurement bounds are in README.
reset_notes: Restore the fixed layout and all 1,960 clean dry spheres. Retract SampleSlide to zero, initialize the standard READY arm poses with open grippers, and settle for 2.5 seconds. Reuse the same weighed batch of spheres between physical trials.
fidelity: Native rigid contact, gravity and CCD run at 240 Hz. One passive 25 mm slide has a constant 20 N/m return spring and 60 mm preload. The integral floor moves with the notched rod. The rectangular pocket/sleeve and 6.8 mm clean spheres define the granular setup; printable models and assembly drawings are supplied. The prismatic joint represents the guide bearing and mechanical end stops.
